youtube.baslik: Why do central auditory tests use deliberately degraded speech? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Speech carries more information than is needed to understand it, and the auditory pathways contain many parallel and crossed connections; thanks to this redundancy, a mild central problem can stay hidden. Low-redundancy tests, such as speech with the high frequencies filtered out, reduce this redundancy to reveal a hidden problem; the 1954 study by Bocca and colleagues is considered the start of central auditory testing.
